intended_object: The operator P_P((α+δ)I − A)P_P on H: the compression of the shifted operator (α+δ)I − A to the subspace P, extended by zero on Pᗮ. It is an intermediate operator in the library's proof of the Davis–Kahan sin Θ theorem (from the docstring and the module documentation).
explanation: This is a helper construction for the library's Davis–Kahan proof, not a standard mathematical notion. The module documentation lists it as one of four named "blocks" used for form evaluation and positivity arguments. It is the mirror image of `upperBlockShift`, obtained by sending A ↦ −A and α ↦ −(α+δ). The body matches the docstring exactly: `P.starProjection ∘L ((α+δ)•id − A) ∘L P.starProjection`. That is the lower compression (α+δ) − A₀ on P, extended by zero off P. It is already stated generically, over any `RCLike` field and any Hilbert space with an orthogonally complemented subspace, so there is no generality problem either. Because it is proof scaffolding, it has no counterpart in the mathematical literature, so the verdict is `not_a_mathematical_object`.
